proof_body:
by
  intro V _ _ a b ha hb
  have hn : 0 < ‖a‖ * ‖b‖ := by positivity
  unfold InnerProductGeometry.angle
  constructor
  · rw [Real.arccos_lt_pi_div_two, div_pos_iff_of_pos_right hn]
  · rw [← not_le, ← not_le, Real.arccos_le_pi_div_two, div_nonneg_iff]
    constructor
    · intro h h'
      rcases h' with ⟨h1, _⟩ | ⟨_, h2⟩
      · exact h h1
      · exact absurd h2 (not_le.mpr hn)
    · intro h h'
      exact h (Or.inl ⟨h', hn.le⟩)
target_source: ∀ (V : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] (a b : V), a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → (0 < inner ℝ a b ↔ InnerProductGeometry.angle a b < Real.pi / 2) ∧ (inner ℝ a b < 0 ↔ Real.pi / 2 < InnerProductGeometry.angle a b)
